title: Cardinal Billing Account Late Fees: Charged Share After Partial Payment and on Small Installments
content:
**Rule.** The charged share of the late-fee amount on a Cardinal Billing Account installment depends on what was paid toward the installment. When the payments posted less than one whole month before the charge date, less the returned payments posted in that same window, are above zero but do not cover the installment total (the installment's premium plus its installment fee), the charged share is the late-fee amount multiplied by the unpaid part of the installment total and divided by the installment total. When nothing was paid in that window and the installment total is under $100.00, the charged share is ten percent (10 percent) of the installment total, in place of the late-fee amount. In every other case the charged share is the whole late-fee amount. The late fee charge is figured on the charged share.

## Terms

- **Charge date**: the day the late fee charge is posted.
- **Window**: every record posted less than one whole month before the charge date, counted on calendar months.
- **Paid in the window**: the payments posted on the account in the window, less the returned payments posted in the same window.
- **Installment total**: the premium of the installment charged plus the installment fee charged on it.
- **Unpaid part**: the installment total less what was paid in the window, never below zero.

## Decision matrix

| Paid in the window | Installment total | Charged share |
|---|---|---|
| Above zero, less than the installment total | Any | Late-fee amount multiplied by the unpaid part, divided by the installment total |
| Zero or less | Under $100.00 | 10 percent of the installment total |
| Zero or less | $100.00 or more | Whole late-fee amount |
| Equal to or above the installment total | Any | Whole late-fee amount |

## Worked figures (hypothetical late-fee amount $15.00)

- Installment total $150.00; $60.00 paid in the window, none returned. Unpaid part $90.00. Charged share: $15.00 multiplied by $90.00, divided by $150.00, that is $9.00.
- Installment total $80.00; nothing paid in the window. $80.00 is under $100.00, so the charged share is 10 percent of $80.00, that is $8.00.
- Installment total $100.00; nothing paid in the window. $100.00 is not under $100.00, so the charged share is the whole $15.00.
- Installment total $150.00; a $60.00 payment posted in the window was returned in the window. Paid in the window is zero; $150.00 is not under $100.00, so the charged share is the whole $15.00.
